breakOnShutdown.description: If the breakOnShutdown attribute is true, then the loop will not iterate until it reaches the end when Camel is shut down.

copy.description: If the copy attribute is true, a copy of the input Exchange is used for each iteration. That means each iteration will start from a copy of the same message. By default loop will loop the same exchange all over, so each iteration may have different message content.

description.description: Sets the description of this node

disabled.description: Disables this EIP from the route.

doWhile.description: Enables the while loop that loops until the predicate evaluates to false or null.

expression.description: Expression to define how many times we should loop. Notice the expression is only evaluated once, and should return a number as how many times to loop. A value of zero or negative means no looping. The loop is like a for-loop fashion, if you want a while loop, then the dynamic router may be a better choice.

id.description: Sets the id of this node

onPrepare.description: Uses the Processor when preparing the org.apache.camel.Exchange for each loop iteration. This can be used to deep-clone messages, or any custom logic needed before the looping executes.
